svg.text: Planner – Event-Driven Production Integration & Real-Time Dashboard Architecture
ASP.NET Core + Angular 21 + RabbitMQ + Read Models + SignalR
External · one or more SQL Server DBs
never named after Planner UI actions
Planner never calls these applications — each one subscribes to the same integration events directly.
Adding a consumer = adding a queue binding. No change to the Worker or to Planner.
NOT a full copy of the Production DB — only the data and
shape that Planner queries & dashboards need.
PRIMARY dashboard read model · persisted table, not a DTO
ASP.NET Core Web API · Clean Architecture
Sent only after the read model
One GET on page load returns the full
✕ No REST request per live change
— Angular gets the full dataset once
— no polling, no reload, no extra REST call
Ordering guarantee: the read model is committed BEFORE the SignalR notification is sent.
A client can always re-load from REST and get the same state it was pushed — the Planner read model, not SignalR, is the source of truth.
Production DB remains authoritative for production data
Planner DB is authoritative only for Planner-owned data
Planner read models are optimized for Planner queries
Integration Worker is independent of Planner
REST API provides the initial state
SignalR is not the source of truth — the Planner Read Model is
Read model is updated before the SignalR notification
Future applications can consume the same integration events
